notes.subject: יורדי בור
notes.rationale: 'Ol man i save go daunbilo long hol' i kamap tupela taim — korus i stilim Tsur i go long Seol wantaim ol man bilong taim bipo.

notes.subject: צבי
notes.rationale: 'Gutpela sindaun / kala / praiz' — BSB 'set in splendor' i ridim צבי olsem praiz bilong Tsur yet; KJV/JPS i ridim olsem Yahwe i putim glori.

translation: na mi bai salim yu i go daunbilo wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol man i save go daunbilo long hol, long ol man bilong taim bipo, na mi bai putim yu long graun daunbilo, olsem ol hap graun nating bilong taim bipo, wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol man i save go daunbilo long hol, bilong yu no ken save stap gen; na mi bai putim ⟨את⟩ gutpela sindaun long graun bilong ol man i gat laip.
